title: Employee Salary Rank Deviation
scenario: Calculate how many salary ranks an employee is from the top earner in their division.
tableSchema: staff (emp_id INT, div_id INT, salary INT)
hint: Use RANK() and then subtract rank from the max rank.
correctQuery: SELECT emp_id, (MAX(rnk) OVER(PARTITION BY div_id) - rnk) AS rank_dist FROM (SELECT emp_id, div_id, RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY div_id ORDER BY salary DESC) AS rnk FROM staff) t;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE staff (emp_id INT, div_id INT, salary INT);
